statement_1.statement: It is unfair for a girl to stay home doing compound work while brothers leave early for class.
statement_1.reason_in_words: Nakapiripirit: "The girl may not concentrate like aboy"
all_reasons: Nakapiripirit: "The girl may not concentrate like aboy"
Amudat: "both have equal rights to education"
Amudat: "gender is not promoted"
Amudat: "both children should be treated equally"
Moroto: "they should also attend school early"
Moroto: "we all have to succeeds oin education"
Amudat: "it promotes responsibility"
Moroto: "girls must also be at school"
Moroto: "if my parents decide who remians at home, you cannot refuse"
Moroto: "it is good to share roles at home and school"
Kaabong: "Girls will not be able to catch up with the early morning lessons"
Kaabong: "Because we want equal education for all, we all need to work together and leave for school early so that we get equal chances of better performance for all, to promote girl child education"

statement_2.statement: Boys and girls should finish morning chores at the same time so both eat porridge and walk to school together.
all_reasons: Nakapiripirit: "To make work easy"
Amudat: "promotes friendship at home"
Amudat: "All of them should be given orpotunity to do house chores  for,self reliance and avoid dependancy"
Amudat: "beacuse these children should fill that both of them have responsibilities besides their sex"
Moroto: "girls are favored with food especilly  at home"
Moroto: "girls eat alot"
Amudat: "it promotes qeuality"
Moroto: "girls dont like porriage"
Moroto: "if there is available food to eat or porriage"
Moroto: "i agree to help my sister to cook and eat together"
Kaabong: "It makes work very easy"
Kaabong: "It is very bad to leave your sister alone at home while you go to school, to promote love between boys and girls, to ensure equal performance"

statement_3.statement: Collecting firewood for cooking is a chore that boys and girls should do together.
statement_3.reason_in_words: Nakapiripirit: "To offer campany to and security to girls from rapiest"
all_reasons: Nakapiripirit: "To offer campany to and security to girls from rapiest"
Amudat: "it promotes respect for both"
Amudat: "it promotes reliability of boys"
Amudat: "all sex should be treated equally"
Moroto: "it is good to support each other with chores"
Moroto: "girls are the ones who work often at home"
Amudat: "it promotes leadership"
Moroto: "we use charcoal for cooking at home"
Moroto: "it is good for all children to help at home work"
Moroto: "but girls are the ones who fetch forewood always"
Kaabong: "It helps protect the other incase something happens on the way, shows respect to the girl child"
Kaabong: "We should move or work together for security and protection purposes, to promote peace at home, to promote equal responsibilities at home, promotes equal treatment among boys and girls"

statement_4.statement: I am ready to fetch water from borehole in morning so my sister is not late/punished.
all_reasons: Nakapiripirit: "Share work with my sister"
Amudat: "it promotes displine"
Amudat: "it promotes displine among children"
Amudat: "girls should be left behind alone"
Moroto: "my sister should also pass very well at school"
Moroto: "if she also helps me in other home chores, i will help her too"
Amudat: "it reduces work load"
Moroto: "but my mother pays someone who can collect water from the borehole"
Moroto: "i have to help my brother"
Moroto: "if my sister also is doing another work i can help to fetch water"
Kaabong: "Shows love to my sister, promoting gender equality"
Kaabong: "For girls not to be punished, to show love to our sisters, to show respect to our sisters, to promote togetherness"

statement_5.statement: If a girl misses school to herd animals or do chores I will speak up to get her back to class.
statement_5.reason_in_words: Nakapiripirit: "Girls are not to look after animas while boys go to school"
all_reasons: Nakapiripirit: "Girls are not to look after animas while boys go to school"
Amudat: "promotes hardwork"
Amudat: "it avoids work laod on one gender"
Amudat: "all of them have rights for education"
Moroto: "Girls are not suppose to be with the animals for long hours"
Moroto: "not good work for the girls"
Amudat: "it promote cost share"
Moroto: "my mother may punish me"
Moroto: "herding cattle is not good work for girls"
Moroto: "all children must be at school not to take care of animals"
Kaabong: "Because girls should also be given an opportunity to be in school, educating a girl child is like educating anation so they should not be left behind"
Kaabong: "To reduce the rates of school dropouts, to control early pregnancies, to reduce early marriages"

dimensions.title: Pillar 1: School Feeding & Practical Nutrition
dimensions.summary: 33.7% of interviewed learners across 14 Visit 2 activations demonstrated actionable local fortification knowledge.
evidence_points: 28 learners gave specific, actionable local fortification recipes without prompting
60 teacher & VHT exit interviews completed across 9 oriented schools
Community cooking demonstration rollout pending (0 of 640 conducted)

dimensions.title: Pillar 2: Gender Dynamics & Equitable Morning Chores
dimensions.summary: 69.5% of participants in Visit 2 micro-polls and intercepts affirmed boys and girls must share domestic water/firewood chores equally.
evidence_points: 57 of 75 learners stated boys and girls should share water/wood chores equally before leaving
514 boy responses recorded across 5 micro-poll statements with 99.4% agreement rate (511 agreements) affirming gender chore rebalancing

9 NutriClubs active (KAKAMAR P/S, KARENGA BOYS P/S, KARENGA GIRLS P/S, LOBALANGIT P/S, LOOKOROK P/S, MARY MOTHER OF GOD P/S, NAKAPELIMORU P/S, NALAKAS P/S, kawalakol P/S with 316 registered members) delivering practical chore rebalancing dialogue
Longitudinal attendance tracking initiated (21613 learners logged across Visit 1 and Visit 2)

dimensions.title: Pillar 3: Community Accountability & Climate-Smart Living
dimensions.summary: 100% of oriented school leadership and VHTs (9 schools) agreed on joint 4-week calendars with signed action plans.
evidence_points: 9 primary schools completed multi-stakeholder orientation sessions
437 persons with disabilities accommodated and included across sessions
0 retaliation complaints recorded on the WFP toll-free hotline (0800)
